# Journey Home Baltimore

> Journey Home Baltimore is an educational platform addressing homelessness, housing affordability, and government benefits in Baltimore and beyond.

The organization focuses on housing insecurity, homelessness prevention, and financial assistance programs. The site provides guides on housing affordability, government benefits like SNAP and Social Security, and analysis of factors driving housing instability in low-income communities.

## Key Topics

- Housing affordability
- Homelessness prevention
- SNAP work rules
- Government benefits
- Housing insecurity
- Low-income renters
- Social Security benefits
- USDA regulations
- Rental costs
- Utility bills
- Baltimore housing crisis
- Food assistance programs
- Eligibility requirements
- Welfare policy

## Housing & Homelessness Prevention

- [What Does "Housing Affordability" Really Mean?](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/what-is-housing-affordability): Guide explaining housing affordability, 30% rule, and income-housing ratios.
- [The Hidden Costs of Renting That Push Families Toward Homelessness](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/hidden-costs-of-renting): Analysis of hidden rental costs driving housing insecurity and homelessness.
- [How Rising Utility Bills Impact Low-Income Renters](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/rising-utility-bills-impact-low-income-renters): Impact of rising utility bills on low-income renters and housing stability.

## Government Benefits & Assistance Programs

- [New SNAP Work Rules Shock Recipients - What Changes In January 2026 Could Mean For You](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/usda-new-snap-work-rules-january-2026): USDA introduces new SNAP work rules starting January 2026 affecting ABAWDs.
- [How To Get The Maximum Social Security Benefit In 2026 Explained Simply](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/maximum-social-security-benefit-2026-rule): Guide to maximum Social Security benefits in 2026 with eligibility rules.
- [600,000 Americans Can Claim Alaska Stimulus Checks In 2026 With Simple Rules](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/alaska-pfd-stimulus-checks-2026): Alaska PFD 2026 stimulus eligibility, payment amounts, and application guide.
- [$147 Payments Approved Under Cash App Settlement For U.S. Residents](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/cash-app-147-settlement-payments-approved): Cash App settlement details for Washington residents with payment eligibility.

## Lifestyle & Wellness

- [Farewell To Happiness - The Age When It Begins To Fade, According To Science](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/age-when-happiness-starts-to-fade-science): Scientific research on the midlife happiness slump and emotional wellbeing.
- [Science Reveals The Age When Happiness Begins To Fade](https://journeyhomebaltimore.org/age-happiness-fades): Science-based explanation of age-related happiness changes and wellbeing.
